resources.string: Choose Texpod as your text-to-speech engine, then turn on Read aloud in any app.

There is a particular kind of quiet that belongs only to reading. It is not an empty quiet, but one filled with imagined voices, distant places, and the soft rhythm of a page turning.

Texpod gives that rhythm a second home. Your reading app sends its words to Android’s text-to-speech engine. Instead of speaking them, Texpod turns them into a calm, beautifully simple page.

You can follow along here, connect an e-ink reader, or simply pause and enjoy the stillness. Move backward to find a sentence you loved. Move forward when you are ready. The words wait for you.

This sample lives entirely on your phone. It is a small invitation to slow down, make yourself comfortable, and read one more page.
